meta.title: Hoi An (Vietnam) Is Even More Beautiful Than I Expected 🇻🇳
meta.description:
I spent a day exploring Hoi An, Vietnam 🇻🇳 and honestly, it was the perfect way to end my Vietnam adventure. From wandering the colourful streets of the Old Quarter and discovering beautiful hidden corners of the city, to an unexpected encounter with one of the funniest locals I’ve met, Hoi An had something waiting around every corner.

I also revisited a tailor I first discovered two years ago at RoRo Tailor, enjoyed coffee with an incredible view over the city, and ended the day by making my very own traditional Hoi An lantern 🏮

comments.author: @AVA_Investment_Analytics_Live
comments.text:
Beautiful? I was just in Hoi An and it has become a total dump and the food was overpriced and terrible. There was trash all along the Old Quarter lake and all of the street lamps were flat on the ground which not only looked ridiculous, but it presented a huge safety issue.  Hoi An is not even a legit UNESCO site anymore because today it exists solely to make money from tourists. It's just a money grab. It's essentially become a fake city.  When you see boat tours in the lake whereby there's so many boats that you're surrounded by them, you know it's just a money grab. These vloggers always tell you every place they visit is beautiful, amazing etc. and they only show you the good side, not the full side because all they care about is making money from scammy ad sales and scammy affiliate links.

Unfortunately, Vietnam does not know how to or care to practice sustainable tourism, so every place that gets popular is soon overrun by vendors who swarm the area and transform it into a S----show. The same thing has happened to Danang, Sapa, Ha Long Bay and Phu Quoc....totally s--shows.  Don't waste your time watching anyone who states otherwise. I wish the situation were different because I live in Vietnam, but it's not. And I have learned the hard way. Now I only travel to places in Vietnam that these ScamTubers aren't featuring which is why I'm not disclosing the names of those places (to keep them good).
